name: Carl G. Anderson
tagline: Top rated Intellectual Property Litigation attorney in San Francisco, California
about: Carl G. Anderson is an attorney who represents clients in the San Francisco, California area. Carl Anderson is recognized by peers and was selected to Rising Stars for 2013 - 2015. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Carl Anderson chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Stanford Law School and graduated in 2005. Carl Anderson passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2005.
He represents clients with Intellectual Property Litigation issues in California. He also represents clients with Intellectual Property issues.

Being selected to Rising Stars is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Rising Stars, Carl Anderson has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
